1.label: very_easy
1.summary: Extract one diamond from one voxel pocket with no lava or fragile support and six spare pick strikes.

2.label: easy
2.summary: Extract two hidden diamonds from two view-bound pockets with no lava or fragile support and five spare pick strikes.

3.label: medium
3.summary: Extract three hidden diamonds across three viewpoints while avoiding one lava block. Four spare pick strikes remain.

4.label: hard
4.summary: Extract the current four diamonds across all viewpoints while avoiding lava and fragile support. One screen hides the first pocket and two spare pick strikes remain.

5.label: very_hard
5.summary: Extract five diamonds across repeated viewpoints while avoiding two lava blocks and fragile support. Two spare pick strikes remain.
